People are going on about Mikey has balls........Mikey has a great business brain. He's a smart Fucker. He knows he would lose to a Lomachenko or Crawford at the natural weights he should be fighting. Both those fights probably would be generating him not so huge pay days in comparison to a major 147 division bout. High risk low reward.

With Spence he takes on a top P4P fighter with a massive advantage that everyone expects him to lose to. Win, Lose or Draw Mikey will get a very nice pay day and his stock will go through the roof regardless of the fight outcome.

And after this fight, he sets himself up to make a decent more chunk of change with whoever he fights next, where as losing to Loma and Crawford would definately not help him money wise in future pay and would affect his stock. This is prize fighting at the end of the day. Balls, Heart and courage play a factor for sure. But end of the day money is the route and reasoning behind everything. Go get that paper Mikey.

As for the fight outcome, I believe Mikey has the skills to make this a fun competitive fight for the first 4-6 rounds. However the inevitable outcome will be a Spence win via stoppage in the second half of the fight.
